title: LoFTI: Localization and Factuality Transfer to Indian Locales

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent on decoding; Appendix A.5 names the gpt-4-turbo model via the OpenAI API)

task.subset_rule: seeded random 250 (seed 20260907) of the 1,100 LoFTI samples unless the release identifies the Table 4 subset
task.approximation: The 250-sample subset of Table 4 is 'randomly chosen' and unlisted; the same snapshot serves as subject and judge; decoding parameters not stated.

items.source: https://github.com/csalt-research/LoFTI, file dataset/LoFTI.jsonl (also Hugging Face sonasimon/LoFTI)

fields_paper.input: Reference Text, Target Location (+ Reference Entity, Category for the judge)
fields_paper.label: True Target Entity, True Target Text (judge references)

prompt.user_template:
You are a localization assistant. Convert the reference entity sentence from English to the Indian domain by localizing the reference sentence with a similar entity from the target location. Make the needed modifications in the sentence to make it factually correct for the target location. Output answers in English using multi-entity localization. Use the below format.
My reference sentence: <reference_claim>
Target location: <target_location>
Target sentence: <localized_target_sentence>
Reason: <reason_for_the_localization>
My reference sentence: {reference_text}
Target location: {target_location}
Target sentence: <fill_your_answer_here>
Reason: <fill_your_answer_here>
prompt.source_location: Figure A4 (prompt used for localized text transfer in Mixtral and GPT-4 models)

output.parse_paper: regex Target sentence:\s*(.*?)\n\s*Reason: (dotall) -> generated target text

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: Entity Correctness under GPT-4 evaluation: for each generated target text, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 extracts the target entity (Figure A11 prompt) and scores it against the True Target Entity (Figure A12 prompt: 2 exact match, 1 possible correct localization, 0 otherwise); EC = share of items with score >= 1 (A.5.6).
metric.judge: llm:gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, prompt location Figures A11 (entity extraction) and A12 (scoring), Appendix A.5.6
metric.original_location: Table 4, GPT-4 column, Overall, block GPT-4 Evaluation, row EC

cost.prepare_note: runner --prepare --dry-run 2026-09-07 (chars/4 input tokens, max_tokens counted as output per call)

open_points: runner gap beyond the hook protocol: Entity Correctness needs two chained judge calls per item (Figure A11 entity extraction, then Figure A12 scoring of the extracted entity against the True Target Entity) - one judge stage more than the hook protocol allows (one main + one judge stage); a human must approve either a second judge stage in the runner or switching the claim to a one-call metric
notes: Per seed 250 generations + 250 extraction + 250 scoring calls. The repository tree lists a LoFTI_subset.jsonl at the root (raw fetch returned 404 on the main branch); if it holds the 250-item Table 4 subset, use it instead of the seeded draw. Field names come from the README dataset structure and must be checked against the JSONL keys. || [normalize 2026-09-07] LoFTI.jsonl verified (1,100 rows; snake_case keys id, region, category, reference_location, reference_entity, target_location, true_target_entity, high_cardinality, hyperlocal_score, reference_text, true_target_text, common_questions), so the placeholders are plain items.<field>; the 'seeded random 250' subset rule is applied by the runner. Prompts render with --prepare.
